tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Ground of every panel, tooltip and menu. In-game it sits at 90% over the world: use surface-glass there.

tokens.name: surface-glass
tokens.usage: Panels floating over the 3D world (Panel, Tooltip, action bar dock). Text on it follows the surface rules.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: The empty part of a unit bar, cast bar track and icon wells. The bar IS the frame: no extra backdrop around it.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Buttons, action button wells, hovered rows.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Thin tracks under 2–6px bars (power line, drain lines, XP and reputation bars).

tokens.name: world
tokens.usage: Stand-in for the game world behind previews and mockups. Never ship it in-game.

tokens.name: gilt
tokens.usage: Ornament only: diamond corners, the divider jewel, the minimap ring and north marker. Never a state, never body text.

tokens.name: gilt-text
tokens.usage: Panel titles, section headers and the active tab, set in `header`, on surface, surface-glass and surface-sunk (11.9:1).

tokens.name: gilt-line
tokens.usage: 1px borders of panels and anchors (player frame, minimap, action bar).

tokens.name: gilt-hairline
tokens.usage: 1px border of every unit bar, aura and cooldown icon at rest, and of common-quality item slots.

tokens.name: gilt-faint
tokens.usage: Row dividers inside panels; the border of an empty item slot; the dashed border of an icon whose data is unavailable and of an empty totem slot.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and numbers on surface, surface-glass, surface-sunk, surface-raised (≥14.7:1) and on unit-fill / unit-fill-low (≥4.8:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (class, subtitles, meta, chat timestamps) on surface and surface-sunk (6.8:1). Never on a health fill (2.1:1).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled and dead units only (3.9:1 on surface — below 4.5:1 on purpose: disabled text is exempt).

tokens.name: unit-fill
tokens.usage: Healthy health fill (right end of the gradient from unit-fill-deep). Neutral on purpose: health is not a state until it is low. 3.05:1 against surface-sunk.

tokens.name: unit-fill-deep
tokens.usage: Left end of the healthy health-fill gradient.

tokens.name: unit-fill-low
tokens.usage: Health fill below the low threshold (35%), right end of the gradient from unit-fill-low-deep. ink on it 4.8:1.

tokens.name: unit-fill-low-deep
tokens.usage: Left end of the low-health gradient.

tokens.name: ghost
tokens.usage: Recent damage: the segment the fill just lost, drained away by motion after the truth has already updated.

tokens.name: arcane
tokens.usage: READY / ACTIONABLE: a cooldown that is up, an interruptible cast, the suggested action, your own position, a quest ready to turn in, an unspent point in the micro menu. As text, on surface and surface-sunk (10.4:1).

tokens.name: arcane-soft
tokens.usage: Well behind arcane icons and the suggested action button.

tokens.name: arcane-glow
tokens.usage: Glow around ready icons and the interruptible cast bar. Glows only ever come in a state colour.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: DANGER: aggro on a non-tank, a tank losing a mob for good, low health, a lethal cast. Borders, badge fills, the alert hairlines. As text use ember-text.

tokens.name: ember-text
tokens.usage: Danger text (alert titles, low-health %) on surface, surface-sunk and ember-soft (≥8.5:1).

tokens.name: ember-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the danger Alert.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: WARNING: low mana, an expiring aura, threat closing in (a tank about to lose a mob), a timeline ability under 5 seconds. As text on surface (10.4:1).

tokens.name: fel
tokens.usage: HEALING: incoming heals and heal-over-time drain lines. Never a 'success' colour for UI chrome.

tokens.name: fel-incoming
tokens.usage: Incoming-heal segment after the health fill (3.3:1 against surface-sunk): present, never louder than the health itself.

tokens.name: ward
tokens.usage: PROTECTED: a big defensive, an external (Blessing of Protection, Pain Suppression) or a shield is active. Border of the warded unit and of defensive aura icons.

tokens.name: ward-absorb
tokens.usage: Absorb-shield segment on the health bar, hatched.

tokens.name: dispel-magic
tokens.usage: Magic debuff you can remove: unit border, debuff icon border, badge fill.

tokens.name: dispel-curse
tokens.usage: Curse debuff you can remove.

tokens.name: dispel-poison
tokens.usage: Poison debuff you can remove.

tokens.name: dispel-disease
tokens.usage: Disease debuff you can remove.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on any signal fill (ember, amber, arcane, ward, the dispel colours, gilt-text): ≥6.1:1 on all of them. Never white.

tokens.name: mana
tokens.usage: Mana power line.

tokens.name: rage
tokens.usage: Rage power line.

tokens.name: energy
tokens.usage: Energy power line.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus power line (hunter pets). 4.2:1 against track.

tokens.name: progress-fill
tokens.usage: XP and reputation fill. Neutral on purpose: progress is not a state. 3.9:1 against track.

tokens.name: progress-rested
tokens.usage: Rested XP: the hatched segment after the XP fill.

tokens.name: class-warrior
tokens.usage: Class chip (the 5px diamond before a name, on unit frames, the minimap and in chat). Class colours are identity, never state, never a whole bar (one opt-in exception: the damage meter's class-coloured bars, darkened so ink names stay readable).

tokens.name: class-paladin
tokens.usage: Class chip.

tokens.name: class-hunter
tokens.usage: Class chip.

tokens.name: class-rogue
tokens.usage: Class chip.

tokens.name: class-priest
tokens.usage: Class chip.

tokens.name: class-shaman
tokens.usage: Class chip (3.9:1 on surface — fine for a chip, never as text).

tokens.name: class-mage
tokens.usage: Class chip.

tokens.name: class-warlock
tokens.usage: Class chip.

tokens.name: class-druid
tokens.usage: Class chip.

tokens.name: quality-poor
tokens.usage: Item names and the 1px item-slot border, poor quality, on surface (6.9:1).

tokens.name: quality-common
tokens.usage: Item names, common quality. Common slots keep the gilt-hairline border: white is the baseline, not a signal.

tokens.name: quality-uncommon
tokens.usage: Item names and the 1px item-slot border, uncommon quality.

tokens.name: quality-rare
tokens.usage: Item names and slot borders, rare quality. The game's own colour: 3.9:1 on surface, below 4.5:1 — set rare names in `label` or larger. As a border it clears 3:1.

tokens.name: quality-epic
tokens.usage: Item names and slot borders, epic quality. The game's own colour: 3.8:1 on surface, below 4.5:1 — set epic names in `label` or larger. As a border it clears 3:1.

tokens.name: quality-legendary
tokens.usage: Item names and slot borders, legendary quality.

tokens.name: reaction-hostile
tokens.usage: GAME COLOUR, text only: names of hostile units on nameplates and unit tooltips (4.7:1 on surface). Never a bar fill or border.

tokens.name: reaction-neutral
tokens.usage: GAME COLOUR, text only: names of neutral units (17.5:1).

tokens.name: reaction-friendly
tokens.usage: GAME COLOUR, text only: names of friendly NPCs (13.7:1).

tokens.name: chat-say
tokens.usage: GAME COLOUR, chat text only: Say (18.8:1 on surface).

tokens.name: chat-yell
tokens.usage: Chat text: Yell (5.4:1).

tokens.name: chat-emote
tokens.usage: Chat text: Emote (7.5:1).

tokens.name: chat-party
tokens.usage: Chat text: Party (8.8:1).

tokens.name: chat-raid
tokens.usage: Chat text: Raid (7.4:1).

tokens.name: chat-raid-warning
tokens.usage: Chat text: Raid Warning (5.5:1).

tokens.name: chat-guild
tokens.usage: Chat text: Guild (13.9:1).

tokens.name: chat-officer
tokens.usage: Chat text: Officer (7.9:1).

tokens.name: chat-whisper
tokens.usage: Chat text: Whisper, in and out (8.7:1).

tokens.name: chat-channel
tokens.usage: Chat text: numbered channels such as General and Trade (12.1:1).

tokens.name: chat-system
tokens.usage: Chat text: system messages (17.5:1).

tokens.name: chat-loot
tokens.usage: Chat text: loot and money received (6.0:1). Item links inside keep their quality colour.

tokens.name: quest-impossible
tokens.usage: GAME COLOUR, text only: quest titles far above your level (4.8:1 on surface).

tokens.name: quest-very-difficult
tokens.usage: Quest titles: very difficult (7.5:1).

tokens.name: quest-difficult
tokens.usage: Quest titles: difficult (12.8:1).

tokens.name: quest-standard
tokens.usage: Quest titles: standard (7.8:1).

tokens.name: quest-trivial
tokens.usage: Quest titles: trivial, grey (4.8:1).

tokens.name: rep-hostile
tokens.usage: GAME COLOUR, text only: the standing word for Hated and Hostile. 4.2:1 on surface, below 4.5:1 — set it in `label` or larger, never in caption.

tokens.name: rep-unfriendly
tokens.usage: The standing word for Unfriendly. 3.6:1 on surface, below 4.5:1 — `label` or larger.

tokens.name: rep-neutral
tokens.usage: The standing word for Neutral (9.7:1).

tokens.name: rep-friendly
tokens.usage: The standing word for Friendly, Honored, Revered and Exalted (5.0:1). The bar itself stays progress-fill.

tokens.name: coin-gold
tokens.usage: GAME COLOUR, text only: the 'g' after a gold amount (13.4:1 on surface). Digits stay ink.

tokens.name: coin-silver
tokens.usage: The 's' after a silver amount (11.3:1).

tokens.name: coin-copper
tokens.usage: The 'c' after a copper amount (9.1:1).

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Marcellus SC, a small-caps serif, carries the fantasy voice: names, headers, alerts. Never numbers.

styles.name: unit-name-lg
styles.usage: Player and target names, tooltip titles.

styles.name: unit-name
styles.usage: Party, focus, boss and pet names inside the bar.

styles.name: unit-name-sm
styles.usage: Raid and target-of-target names inside the bar; nameplate names above the bar.

styles.name: header
styles.usage: Panel titles, section headers and tabs, in gilt-text (active) or ink-muted (inactive tabs).

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: StateBadge labels, on-signal ink on a signal fill.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Figtree carries everything that must be read fast: numbers, timers, cast names, tooltips, chat. Numbers always with tabular figures.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Reduces all damage taken by 75% for 10 sec.
styles.usage: Tooltip descriptions, chat lines, settings, longer text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Cast names, list rows, quest titles, item names in lists, button labels.

styles.name: numeric
styles.usage: Health %, cast times, values, money — with tabular figures.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Subtitles, meta, timers under buffs, quest objectives, chat timestamps.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Digits on 24–36px icons and slots, keybinds, stack counts. The smallest size anything may be.

spacing.note: Tight, 2px-based steps for the HUD; the HUD is dense, the gaps are not random.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Power line height and its gap; stacked digits; the gap between a bar and its cast bar.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between icons in an aura or cooldown slot; between a unit bar and its slots; between raid units; between item slots.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between party units; gaps between text inside a bar.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Inner padding of a unit bar; between a header and its hairline.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel padding; header-to-content.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between HUD clusters (party ↔ raid, target ↔ alerts).

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Screen-edge inset of the whole HUD.

radius.note: Nearly square. Round only where the object is round (minimap, portrait).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Unit bars, icons, item slots, badges, buttons, fields.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels, tooltips, alerts, the action bar dock.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Minimap, portraits, the minimap's zoom buttons.

shadow.note: Glows exist only in a state colour. Gilt never glows.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Floating panels, tooltips, the action bar dock.

tokens.name: inset-anchor
tokens.usage: The double gilt frame of an ANCHOR only (player frame, minimap, action bar dock). Never on other unit bars or list rows.

tokens.name: glow-arcane
tokens.usage: Ready cooldowns, the suggested action, interruptible casts.

tokens.name: glow-ember
tokens.usage: A unit in danger (aggro, low health), the danger Alert.

tokens.name: glow-ward
tokens.usage: A warded unit and defensive aura icons.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus in menus, settings, fields, tabs and slots: a 1px surface gap, then 2px solid arcane (≥9.8:1 on every surface).

size.note: Fixed component sizes. The density presets scale these as a set, never one by one.

tokens.name: unit-lg
tokens.usage: Player and target bar height.

tokens.name: unit-md
tokens.usage: Party, focus, boss and pet bar height.

tokens.name: unit-sm
tokens.usage: Raid and target-of-target bar height.

tokens.name: bar-lg
tokens.usage: Width of the player and target bars.

tokens.name: bar-md
tokens.usage: Width of party, focus, boss and pet bars.

tokens.name: bar-tot
tokens.usage: Width of the target-of-target bar.

tokens.name: bar-sm
tokens.usage: Width of an sm bar outside the group frame profiles (previews, lists). Party and raid frames take their sizes from the heal-w, heal-h and side-* tokens.

tokens.name: heal-w
tokens.usage: Healer profiles, every group size: bar width. Class, name, badge and two inline icons inside; power line on tanks and healers. Each group is a row of five.

tokens.name: heal-h
tokens.usage: Healer profiles at 5, 10 and 20 players: bar height.

tokens.name: heal-h-40
tokens.usage: Healer profile at 40 players: bar height, so eight rows fit between the player and target frames and above the dock.

tokens.name: side-w
tokens.usage: Tank and DPS profiles, 10, 20 and 40 players: bar width. Role icon and name on everyone, the state badge at the right end; power line on tanks and healers.

tokens.name: side-h
tokens.usage: Tank and DPS profiles, 10, 20 and 40 players: bar height.

tokens.name: cast
tokens.usage: Player and enemy cast bar height.

tokens.name: cast-sm
tokens.usage: Cast bar under a target, focus or boss bar.

tokens.name: cast-plate
tokens.usage: Cast bar under a nameplate; the spell name sits under it in caption.

tokens.name: swing
tokens.usage: Swing timer bar height: main hand and ranged. The bar runs the width of the player cast bar.

tokens.name: swing-oh
tokens.usage: Off-hand swing bar height, directly under the main hand.

tokens.name: cdm-essential
tokens.usage: Cooldown Manager: Essential cooldown icons. Utility and tracked buffs use icon-lg; tracked bars are cast-sm tall and bar-md wide.

tokens.name: nameplate
tokens.usage: Nameplate health bar height.

tokens.name: nameplate-w
tokens.usage: Nameplate width.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Auras and the relevant cooldown inside a raid bar; debuffs over a nameplate.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Party auras and cooldowns; rows in insight panels.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Player buffs and debuffs, totem slots, your defensives.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Action buttons. The dock holds four bars in two rows: bars 1 and 2 across the middle, bars 3 and 4 as 6 × 2 blocks either side, 538 × 42 px.

tokens.name: action-sm
tokens.usage: Stance, form and pet action buttons.

tokens.name: slot
tokens.usage: Item slots in bags, the bank, loot and loot rolls.

tokens.name: menu-button
tokens.usage: Micro menu buttons.

tokens.name: minimap
tokens.usage: Minimap diameter.

tokens.name: progress
tokens.usage: XP and reputation bar height.

tokens.name: settings-nav
tokens.usage: Width of the section list in the settings window and the activity list in the Group Finder.

tokens.name: map-pin
tokens.usage: World map pins: quest marks, flight masters, dungeons, campsites, your own marks. Group members draw at half size.

tokens.name: meter-row
tokens.usage: Row height of the damage and threat meters. The row is the bar: rank, class chip, name and value sit inside it.

tokens.name: meter-w
tokens.usage: Width of the damage and threat meters. Both are always the same height: 8 rows by default, the damage meter's Rows setting.

tokens.name: chat-w
tokens.usage: Width of the chat: exactly four tank and DPS raid columns (4 × side-w + 3 × space-2), which sit directly above it.

tokens.name: notice-w
tokens.usage: Width of a notification and of the notification stack (top left, under the micro menu).

tokens.name: timeline-w
tokens.usage: Width of the encounter timeline across the top of the screen: now at the left, 30 seconds to the right.

tokens.name: opacity-oor
tokens.usage: A unit out of range.

tokens.name: opacity-ooc
tokens.usage: Unit frames out of combat while everyone is full; snaps to 1 on entering combat.

tokens.name: opacity-plate
tokens.usage: Nameplates that are not your target, so the target reads first.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Unusable actions, disabled controls, item slots that don't match a bag search.

duration.note: Snappy and precise. Truth is instant (dur-instant); only decoration animates, and never longer than dur-slow — except the damage ghost, which trails behind truth by design.

tokens.name: dur-instant
tokens.usage: Every value: health, power, timers, cast progress, state colour changes.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press, icon state swaps, badge in/out.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Ready pop, alert enter, panel fade, aura add/remove.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Combat enter/exit HUD reveal, density preset change, chat ground fading in and out.

tokens.name: dur-ghost
tokens.usage: The damage ghost draining after a 150ms hold.

easing.note: In-game, AnimationGroup smoothing maps: ease-out → OUT, ease-in → IN, ease-in-out → IN_OUT, ease-linear → NONE.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Anything entering or changing state (pop, alert, reveal). The default.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Anything leaving (aura removed, panel hiding).

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Moves between two resting places (density change, layout shifts).

tokens.name: ease-linear
tokens.usage: Time itself: cooldown sweeps, drain lines, cast progress.
